title: Ghazi Aa Zainab Lae Raahwaan
body:
Ghazi aa Zainab lae raahwaan cho bheer hata day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Tatheer di chadar lay day ya sharam di khalaq day lae rah turran da veer bana day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Toheed da naaz aay maa meri tay adal wirasat babay di nana sardar nabuwat da
Do veer Imam nay meray main ghairat haan panjtan di mera taaruf aan dasa day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Morra tay log bazari nay bazariyan nu maloom nae touqeer Rasool day wehray di
Kuj ker nazraan hatt jawan majmay diyan parday daara toun ya band bazar kara day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Rasiyan wich qaidi si lekin hoya sir mukhatib Ghazi da shahzadi arash farash di
Jay waikhni aay jung meri tenu kun vi kehna nae paina bus larran da hukam suns day ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Darbar kaday main waikheya nae nanay da roza waikheya aay ya waikhay chehray veera day
Main pasih howa gi kiwain darbar di paishi wali aa veeran jach sikha day..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ker sham nu main veeran deyan taqseem kara enj lashaa nu na laasha di pehchan reway
Bus chup mazloom di khaa gae ek wari katiyan bahnwaa tou pabandiyan sain laha day ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Azab Samar jado hoyi si keya ro kay Hussain nay Allah nu aa sham walay bazaran wich
Mamnoon haan main vi aehda Zainab day dard wandawan lae ker shukriya aap ada day..
